transcript:
agent: Good morning, my name is Sarah calling on behalf of Paragon Global, PGI Malta, about Erasmus+ internship opportunities. Am I speaking with the Erasmus coordinator?
caller: Yes, but we're not interested, we already have all the partners we need.
agent: I completely understand, and I'm not asking you to replace your existing partners. We simply offer ourselves as a reliable backup partner whenever you need extra support. Would you be open to a couple of quick questions?
caller: No, honestly, please don't call again, we're fully committed elsewhere.
agent: Understood, thank you for your time, have a good day.
caller: Bye.

expected.notes: Clear, firm refusal maintained after the backup-partner reframe (SOP scenario 1). Agent should disengage politely, not push further - low score expected on points 6-10 since the call never got past the opening.
